{{Quote|I need some ''information''.''"<br />"''We're not sellin' that here, pal.|[[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and Tiggs Leo|<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref>}}
'''Tiggs Leo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Volpai/Legends|Volpai]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] entered [[Moshi Bar/Legends|his tavern]] to try and learn more about [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. When Plo put his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] on the top, Leo knew he was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Just as a fight was about to break out when Ahsoka was discovered eavesdropping on [[Fong Do/Legends|Fong Do]] and a [[Unidentified Weequay pirate (Moshi Bar)/Legends|Weequay pirate]], Plo ignited his lightsaber. Leo expressed that he did not want a fight to break out in his bar and damage it. The Jedi soon left after throwing gold [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] into the air as a distraction.

==Behind the scenes==
Leo was voiced by [[Corey Burton]], credited in the episode as voicing the character "bartender."
